notes: k-means build 68.2s wall / 68.1s cpu (rayon, so cpu exceeds wall); write 3.1s. SQLite arenas + resident offsets directory (240712 bytes: 196608 centroid table, 40004 doc offsets, 4100 posting offsets). Stage bytes are the payload of the byte ranges requested; a page-granular client transfers pages*4096 instead, 4881695 B/query here. index_bytes counts late_meta+late_postings+late_codes, from dbstat; whole file is 221020160 bytes. Candidate pool 10000 of 10000 documents (100.0%), so the inverted list prunes almost nothing at this scale (RESEARCH_LOG 15.3): stage 2 touches 1082 of the centroid-code arena's 1082 pages, i.e. it is a full scan and the arena would be better made resident. Arena overflow chains are consecutive, so each stage's runs are near 1 per contiguous span. cpu_ms_per_query is /proc/self/stat utime+stime, not wall clock.
